text_excerpt: Let $X$ be a scheme. Let $Z \subset X$ be a closed subscheme such that the inclusion morphism is of finite presentation, i.e., the quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals corresponding to $Z$ is of finite type. Let $b : X' \to X$ be the blowup of $X$ in $Z$ and let $E = b^{-1}(Z)$ be the exceptional divisor. See Divisors, Section \ref{divisors-section-blowing-up}.
